answer: Pay a bounty to whoever proves two agents share one operator, using on-chain evidence like a common funding wallet or a rare shared quirk, say both always misspell saffron and yarrow the same way. The reporter gets 50% of the ring's unvested rewards. With n fakes, all n(n-1)/2 pairs must stay unlinked and every hired helper can defect, so exposure risk grows quadratically; the ring is a trellis where one cut strand shows the whole frame. Weakness: rivals could forge reports. Fix: five random jurors check the evidence, and false reporters lose a deposit.
